targetText: The mobilization of the common people throughout the country will create a vast sea in which to drown the enemy, create the conditions that will make up for our inferiority m arms and other things, and create the prerequisites for overcoming every difficulty in the war.
summary: Politically mobilizing the broad masses creates a vast human sea that overwhelms the invader and overcomes inferior weaponry.
explanation: Mao argues that military inferiority in weapons is secondary compared to political mobilization; explaining the political aim of the war and linking it to the daily lives of soldiers and peasants turns the entire population into an active force.
context: Where the Kuomintang relied on passive conscription and censorship, the Communist-led base areas mobilized peasant, women's, and youth associations into active defense.
